Those who can't log in, please follow these steps. I hope its worth sharing.  For new user: 1). Go to your home branch and ask for the CIF number. 2). Enter the CIF number and select the activation process through bank. 3). Ask your home branch to activate your account  for mobile banking and wait for otp. Then, enter the otp and set up your username, mpin, and transaction pin/password. Boom!! your are in.  For old user: 1). Reinstall 2). Enter CIF number again. 3). Select through debit card. 4). Wait for otp at your registered mobile number.  Enter the otp and you would be able to log in using your old username and mpin.  And there you go.  I hope, this would help you.  :)
